findings.title: Gate-2 leaf-class patterns have undefined matching semantics; prefix/full-path matching puts all test-side rank leaves at 1e-6 and reintroduces the round-6 stall
findings.fix: Define leaf paths as key tuples relative to runs[i] (no dot-joining; curve keys like '0.1' contain dots); pair per_query rows by 'query' field; classify by segment membership: exact if last in {selected_weight,n_queries} or 'queries_with_both_classes'/'confusion_matrix' in P or (last=='n' and 'tier_stats' in P); rank if any of {validation_selection_curve,ranking,ranking_macro,per_query,global_auc,macro_query_auc} in P or last in {kendall_tau_b,spearman_rho}; skipped if binary_classification/ordinal_classification in P; else continuous. Require coverage of every non-skipped numeric leaf. Unit-test with full key tuples from the real published file plus a coverage-failure test.

findings.title: Inputs-table row pattern not anchored; it also matches the tail of §3b checkpoint rows
findings.fix: Anchor inputs rows to whole lines with exactly two cells (^\|\s*(\S+)[^|]*\|\s*([0-9a-f]{64})\s*\|\s*$) and checkpoint rows to exactly four cells; require exactly 15 and exactly 18; unit-test disjointness.
